prompt_fragment: This asset is a top-down hex tile. Compose it for clear map readability, with the terrain filling the frame evenly and no horizon line.
raw_description:
Orthographic top-down view of a pale glare-ice sheet — faint crackle
pattern, pale blue-white surface, deep slate-blue fracture lines. Looks
cold and slightly translucent.

formatted_prompt.scene: Ink and watercolor hex tile, top-down orthographic view, pale glare-ice sheet with crackle fracture patterns across the full frame, cool blue-white surface punctuated by deep slate-blue fracture lines on aged vellum cream ground.

subjects.description: Flat glare-ice sheet filling the hex frame, faint translucent sheen, fine crackle network of hairline fractures spreading evenly across the surface.
subjects.position: full frame, centered, edge to edge

subjects.description: Deep branching fracture lines pressed into the ice, thin nib-pen linework, slightly irregular, suggesting subsurface depth and cold pressure stress.
subjects.position: distributed evenly across the tile surface
